name: Fetid Fecundity
source:
Danny’s life is as empty as it gets. Dead-end job, no prospects or hope. Nothing to stop the internal rot— until a one-night stand with the mysterious Laura sets the path to change. Change as fundamental yet upheaving as Death itself. Follow Danny/Dani’s journey of rebirth and self-actualization, a necessarily bloody ordeal in a world with little space for the undead.

[From [url=https://maolong.itch.io/fetid-fecundity]itch.io[/url]]
